agent_explanation: Body 1 approaches the right arena wall obliquely at ~18.7 m/s (vx~14.7). From step 102 (x~19.057, just inside) to step 103 (x~19.264, overshoot 0.18) it crosses the boundary with identical vx, i.e. no wall impulse/positional correction was applied despite substep movement per substep (~0.023) being far smaller than radius (0.92). Finer dt still fails at same physical time, so it is not a substep-count tunneling issue but a missed high-speed oblique boundary contact that lets the body sail through.
